Author: yocopk
Name: MogHouse Companion
Punchline: Sync your FFXIV timers to MogHouse and get notified when they are up — even with the game closed.
Description:
Companion plugin for MogHouse (mog-house.com).

Reads the timers you already see in the game's own Timers window (CTRL+U) — submarine and airship voyages, retainer ventures, map and leve allowances, Grand Company missions, custom deliveries, fashion report, allied society dailies — and syncs them to your MogHouse profile. MogHouse then sends you a push notification the moment a timer comes up, on the web app and on mobile, even while the game and your PC are off.

You choose which timers notify you, per character, from mog-house.com/settings/ffxiv. The plugin itself is read-only: it collects your own timers and reports status. It never performs any in-game action.

Link your account with /moghouse. Requires a MogHouse account with an active Mog+ subscription.
